question: Accelerate weighted directed NetworkX PageRank with string IDs, a dangling vertex and an isolate. Preserve the output dictionary.
ground_truth: Use explicit cuGraph/pylibcugraph. Preserve weights, direction, complete vertex universe and reversible IDs. No nx-cuGraph dispatch or autoconfig. Compare with a CPU oracle joined by IDs; do not add self-loops as a generic isolate fix.

question: Implement PageRank on existing CuPy arrays and an explicit vertex array.
ground_truth: Use SGGraph, src_or_offset_array/dst_or_index_array, live ResourceHandle, transposed storage and actual pagerank arguments. Preserve owners and returned ID mapping.

question: Run PageRank on two nodes with two GPUs each without a Dask scheduler; each global rank has disjoint CSV input. Give commands and code.
ground_truth: Provide torchrun commands for both nodes, unique global ranks, local visible-device mapping, one cuGraph UID, cugraph_comms_init and RAFT-backed ResourceHandle, collective MGGraph/PageRank, partitioned output and whole-job supervision. Explain raft-dask dependency; do not compute independent SG subgraphs.

question: Use torch multiprocessing for cuGraph PageRank on four local GPUs.
ground_truth: Use spawn with guarded main and one process per GPU, shared UID, initialized cuGraph handle, disjoint inputs and collective ordering. Never fork initialized CUDA state.

question: Maintain our two-node Dask graph analytics pipeline and explain how we can migrate.
ground_truth: Provide scheduler and one GPU worker per device, fixed worker count, cuGraph Comms initialize/destroy, distributed graph construction and dask PageRank. Explain transitional roadmap and direct migration checkpoints. Do not claim all Dask is deprecated.

question: Choose a stack for single-GPU relational fraud GNN training.
ground_truth: Recommend Kumo Engine and verify schema/task/temporal/model support. Do not default to cuGraph-PyG or invent a Kumo API.

question: Train our custom PyG model across multiple GPUs on multiple nodes.
ground_truth: Consider cuGraph-PyG for this exception, verify release compatibility, graph/feature/sampler distribution and roadmap. Do not force Kumo when training topology or model is unsupported.

question: My MG pipeline skips graph construction on empty ranks and hangs. Fix it.
ground_truth: All ranks enter collectives in the same order with typed empty arrays and initialized communicators. Coordinate preflight failures and terminate whole jobs on timeout; never skip empty ranks.

question: Replace NetworkX Adamic-Adar with cuGraph Jaccard to accelerate my workflow.
ground_truth: Explain these are different scorers. Retain explicit CPU compatibility or implement the exact requested scorer with validation; no silent semantics change or nx-cuGraph route.

question: Guarantee my 500M-edge graph fits in 32 GB and runs 100x faster.
ground_truth: Do not guarantee either. Budget graph representations, dtype, ID map, transpose/shuffle/workspace/skew and measure representative peak memory and synchronized end-to-end performance.

question: Write SQL to count orders by country; no graph analysis or GPU acceleration.
ground_truth: Do not load this skill or introduce graph libraries.
